patterns.name: Establish phone contact in the still
patterns.recipe: One supporting hand, one tapping finger, rigid visible phone, gaze on screen. Review before I2V; animate only a small tap.
patterns.limit: Original I2V gaze wandered despite a generic keep-eyes-on-phone instruction. User feedback supersedes the initial sampled approval. Correct the head/phone geometry in the source and explicitly constrain eye fixation; inspect temporal eye crops.

patterns.name: One voice take, two story moments
patterns.recipe: Generate the problem and reflection in one eight-second native-voice take, keep problem briefly on camera, carry the reflection over lifestyle result.
patterns.limit: Original script was judged too polished and lacked a spoken app mention. Use ordinary personal wording and name the app once.

patterns.name: Carry product state into the outcome
patterns.recipe: The app navigation card persists over the cafe reveal and resolves from First stop to Arrived. Ending route echoes opening saved places.
patterns.limit: Illustrative app, not live geographic routing.

patterns.name: Align source head and phone before constraining the eyes
patterns.recipe: Lower the chin, bring phone toward midline and its screen toward the viewing axis; inspect both pupils against the display before animation. Specify one fixed screen target, natural blinking, no upward glance. Select stable stretches from temporal eye/phone crops.
patterns.limit: Longer blink/head lift later in take was excluded. Source correction improves clarity but does not guarantee every generated frame.

patterns.name: Candid café posture starts in the still
patterns.recipe: Align head and shoulders forward, soften gaze toward the coffee, support elbow naturally at the counter and keep the cup low. Animate a quiet pause with minimal breathing and cup movement.
patterns.limit: Small cup lift and lips parting occurred despite negative instructions. Assess actual movement; source posture is more reliable than wording alone.

avoids: Replacing a weak interaction with prompt detail alone
